method.receptor_index_decode: channel=id//32, level=(id//2)%16, side=id%2; side 0 is >= threshold, side 1 is < threshold
method.same_frame_intervention_selection: First sampled frame >=10.6s with sequence support and actual associative-memory action.

same_frame_sequence_intervention.intervention: Remove only the sequence score addition in this frame's readout.

limitations: This is one registered failed trial, not a new success benchmark.
One-frame sequence removal explains a local current change; it does not predict a complete counterfactual route.
Offline true positions annotate memories after selection and never enter the learner.

interpretation.main_chain: Correct new rule -> perceptually aliased bottom memory from the wrong position/stage -> genuine successor links amplify that starting point -> forward action through top passage.
